To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
it is possible to transmit uncompressed 4K videos over a Terahertz wireless link using a commercially available 4K camera.
we demonstrate the first uncompressed HD and 3K Ultra HD video transmission using Terahertz wireless link.
the Terahertz wireless system for real time transmission of uncompressed HD and 8K video can be built using all commercially off the shelf components.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of the high performance Terahertz wireless systems for real world applications.
the development of Terahertz wireless systems for the transmission of high definition video.
developing a Terahertz wireless technology that can support the next generation of video streaming services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have demonstrated the proof of concept of the Terahertz wireless link capable of supporting uncompressed HD and Ultra HD video streaming.

the Terahertz wireless link can be built using the current state of the art microwave and infrared photonic components and it can support real time streaming of uncompressed HD video at a distance of 1 m.
we demonstrate a working prototype of an uncompressed 4K wireless communication link operating at 138 GHz.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Terahertz wireless link can be used for the transmission of the uncompressed video at the data rates of 4.6 Gbps and 9.2 Gbps for the 4K 50p and 4K 25p video feeds, respectively.
the Terahertz wireless link is capable of supporting uncompressed video transmission at the rate of 4.8 Gbps over a distance of 1 meter, which is sufficient for the 4K video transmission.
the photonics based THz communication systems are now ready for commercial applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Terahertz wireless technology is ready for the commercialization and is capable of supporting high bandwidth applications.
the photonics based hybrid THz wireless communication systems are now ready for commercial deployment and will soon become a viable solution for high speed uncompressed video transmission.
it is now possible, with commercially available components, to assemble a high performance THz wireless link for the transmission of the uncompressed video streams.
